inputs.text: Martin is waving around increased tenancies to make things look better, while eviction notices, homelessness and emergency accommodation are all rising. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 look less like a solution and more like part of the machinery shaping the story: spotlight the number of tenancies, and people may stop asking who is being forced out—and whose interests that serves.

subtopics: Rising eviction notices, homelessness, and emergency accommodation
